data.title: 泽村·斯宾塞·英梨梨 · 数位板前的金发虎牙
data.action: 跨坐在电脑椅上，双手抱着数位板挡在胸前，露出一颗小虎牙气呼呼地瞪着来人，金色双马尾在肩侧炸起，耳根红透得像熟透的苹果。
data.location: 洋房二楼画室，桌上数位屏还亮着未画完的同人本线稿，散落着彩色马克笔
data.lighting: 数位屏散发的高色温白光正面照亮面容，身后暖黄画室落地灯烘托出凌乱温暖的房间
data.mood: 经典傲娇败犬青梅竹马的炸毛与羞窘，生动活泼趣味十足
data.description: 洋房二楼画室，桌上数位屏还亮着未画完的同人本线稿，散落着彩色马克笔。跨坐在电脑椅上，双手抱着数位板挡在胸前，露出一颗小虎牙气呼呼地瞪着来人，金色双马尾在肩侧炸起，耳根红透得像熟透的苹果。 她微微抬眸轻语——“伦也你这个大笨蛋！没敲门就进同人画师的房间……你绝对、绝对看到了对吧？！杀了你哦！”
data.promptProse: Caught at 3 AM inside her second-floor studio cluttered with colored markers and unfinished manuscript pages, Eriri sits backward on her swivel chair in a forest-green silk and black lace bralette trimmed in gold. Clutching her pen display tablet defensively across her chest, she flashes an indignant fang and glares furiously at the intruder with ears and cheeks flushed crimson. Cool white monitor glow illuminates her face while a warm standing floor lamp softens the messy studio behind her.
data.animaCaption: Sitting backward on her studio chair at night in a forest-green silk and black lace bralette, Eriri hugs her drawing tablet across her chest and glares indignantly with a tiny fang and bright crimson blush. Cool monitor light meets warm floor lamplight across her cluttered desk.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a forest-green silk and black lace underwire bralette edged with fine gold trim and tiny velvet ribbon bows.
